agreements: PPC5 must remain a narrow four-assay prerequisite instrument: D1A supported complete-table selection, D1B observable every-edge public response dependence, D1C frozen-DREAM context-policy value, and D1D DREAM-to-SLEEP total-policy value. It must not expand into the Experience Model flywheel.

THINK, DREAM, and ACT remain frozen; SLEEP may write only a READ candidate-scoring adapter; D1A makes no cognitive call; and the only joint statement is a qualified non-mediational intersection with no fifth hypothesis.

The independent unit remains one accepted recipient-life/common-seed bundle sampled under one locked ordinal-blind generator law, with all paired arms executed from byte-identical pretreatment state and every query, item, clone, endpoint, and edge treated only as a repeated measure.

The paired estimand remains the strict-margin generator-population success probability, equality fails, required-arm missingness gives paired success zero, one-sample D1A safety is life-level, every D1B edge retains separate CUT, TWIN, and SHAM gates, and four assay p-values alone enter Holm.

The provider/audit split, privileged condition-free response projection, shared no-retry DREAM realization, prospective DREAM-independent control capacities, endpoint-local missingness, total D1D downstream execution, and prohibition on post-treatment dose or resource adjustment are retained.

The proposal-level scientific design is promising, but exact bytes control. The current bytes do not realize their own CLOSED_TYPED_CONTRACT_UNION, total controller, acyclic receipt DAG, acceptance grammar, power authority, visibility, or release assertions.

All 26 context bindings in change.json match their current SHA-256 values, but successful generic intake parsing and hash validation are structural evidence only and do not cure the semantic and schema contradictions adjudicated below.

All seventeen blocking critique concerns are accepted. Their finite successor-byte repairs are R01 through R17 below; R18 disposes the human boundary. None may be repaired by implementation convention, fixtures, model behavior, or later run-lock values.

PPC5R5_T01 through PPC5R5_T14 remain necessary but none is passed by proposal prose or this consensus. Their successor forms and exact phase consequences are specified in the acceptance-test dispositions.

The current authority remains NONE_PROPOSAL_ONLY. This REWORK consensus cannot be human-ratified into a technical pass and authorizes no PPC implementation, fixture execution, static sealer, model, tokenizer, embedding, training, behavioral, canary, GPU, or scientific-claim action.

positions.position: Treat phase-pattern prose, scalar success/error next-phase strings, and the status table as enough for implementations to infer all successors and terminals.
Every accepted raw result and every L/R/Q boundary, including R=0, must select exactly one schema-valid successor or terminal without inference, aliases, retries, or implementation defaults.

resolution.rationale: The reviewer position is required. Twenty-two current next-phase values violate the SYMBOL grammar; READ[L], PLAN_READ[L], FLUSH[L], PROVIDER[Q], and R=0 are unclosed; D1D lacks its provider-to-behavior bridge; accepted result classes do not fit operation_result.status; and D1B missing branches conflict with no-retry and create differential opportunity.
resolution.selected_position: Use one closed result-keyed indexed transition machine whose every reachable branch has exactly one successor or one terminal, and make every physical missing call consume and advance or finalize its slot exactly once.
resolution.required_change: Replace scalar success_next_phase/error_next_phase with an ordered result_transition array keyed by a closed transition-result union. Add an indexed_phase AST with family, current index, bound symbol/value, increment, boundary phase, endpoint effect, and terminal reason; materialize READ[L], PLAN_READ[L], FLUSH[L], PROVIDER[Q], all L/R/Q boundaries, R=0, and the D1D PROVIDER[Q]-to-READ[0]/PREDICT bridge. Map FOUND, NOT_FOUND, FINALIZE, PUBLISHED, NO_ADAPTER, TRAIN_FAILED, missing, environment, controller, and model outcomes into that union. Make terminal_payload, terminal vocabulary, status first-match rows, and stage_outcome exhaustive for SCHEDULE_INCOMPLETE, PROVIDER_SEQUENCE_COMPLETE, NO_VALID_ACTION, CONSTRUCTION_FAIL, and every declared terminal. Advance/finalize after each missing physical call with no seed reuse or retry. Regenerate a schema-valid registry and require total reachable-state proofs.

positions.position: The conceptual queue-before/controller-after ordering is sufficient to make queue receipts computable.
The exact pair is mutually ancestral and must be split into a pre-controller body and a downstream receipt.

resolution.rationale: Exact preimages, not conceptual intent, determine acyclicity. Neither current digest can be computed first.
resolution.selected_position: Split each slot into an upstream queue-slot body embedded by controller-after and a downstream receipt that may reference controller-after but is not embedded by it.
resolution.required_change: Inventory QUEUE_SLOT_BODY with slot, seed ordinal, operation/request refs, and QUEUED/REJECTED state but no controller-after hash. Store queue_slot_body_hash in private_controller_receipt. Build QUEUE_SLOT_RECEIPT only after controller-after, referencing the body and controller-after, and bind it from transition_event through a cause-specific role. Publish genesis, queue, flush, discard, terminal, and empty-list known-answer hash vectors and an explicit DAG-reachability rejection of all self or mutual ancestry.

resolution.rationale: Conditioning validity on continuing along the authentic path would erase the behavioral dependence being measured. Bare hashes and booleans cannot establish every-edge sufficiency, parity, or source identity.

Replace ordered_p_values with four HOLM_STEP records containing sorted index, claim_id, assay_ref, exact p, divisor, threshold, reject/stop, and claim-ID tie break.

disagreements.issue: The proposal and reviewers ask whether current bytes should be ratified, whether technical blockers should be delegated to Rohin, whether conditional power may supersede r4, what proof closure and stage order are required, and whether any implementation/model/GPU/science authority follows.

positions.position: Rohin could choose among unresolved technical alternatives or ratify current intent and let implementation repair the bytes.

The adjudicator must select technical dispositions, route exact current bytes to rework, and reserve for Rohin only later explicit ratification of a fully repaired exact successor and separately populated run lock.

resolution.rationale: All technical questions are answered by R01-R17: require a byte-revised successor; preserve r4 unconditional complete-release power; make T02-T13 pre-model; close every authority-bearing proof target; add candidate-decision visibility and an acyclic T14 chain; and require later scientific scrutiny of populated values. The premise of the current change's proceed-only ratification question is false.
resolution.selected_position: Do not ratify or implement current v5r5 bytes. Permit only proposal-byte rework followed by a fresh full deliberation; human choice is limited to exact later architecture and run ratification, never technical gap filling.

Aggregate overlap counts lack unit memberships, keys, and source refs.
